items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1961-04-07
items.q: Solstern was at Suburban Garden, you see. And he sent for me to come back here, you see. And I made my money by coming back to the Suburban Garden, you see.

ctx.x: Yeah. Steamboat. I went up to St. Louis. But Solstern was at Suburban Garden, you see. And he sent for me to come back here, you see. And I made my money by coming back to the Suburban Garden, you see. We did on the boat, the Boat didn't pay much. We was glad to have him. But we made good at the Suburban Garden.
And after that time did you always play four beats rather than two?
